notes.title: Ultra Maze Playtest Now Open to Everyone – Are You Ready for the Challenge?
notes.notes: [p]The Ultra Maze Playtest is entering the next round – and this time, EVERYONE can join! Dive into the procedurally generated maze and face the ultimate challenge.[/p][p]Can you escape the maze and skillfully avoid the hunters? Prove your skills solo or team up with up to three friends in co-op mode using Steam Remote Play Together.[/p][p]What are you waiting for? The maze is calling – dare to enter and show what you’re made of![/p]
